title: FBR IRIS 2.0 Return Filing Manual

title: FBR IRIS 2.0 Return Filing Manual
content: IRIS 2.0 PARL FBR PAKISTAN DASHBOARD SCREEN After successful login, IRIS 2.0 Dashboard Screen shall appear, the taxpayer will click on "Declaration" from the mega menu on the top of the screen. The taxpayers can also use the quick link "File Your Income Tax Return", available right below the mega menu.
